title: WG: should providers SHOULD support room_metadata (0x0023)?
description: With mls-extensions-11 §5, a room with a name or avatar (room_metadata in the GroupContext) can include only members whose clients list room_metadata in app_components. protocol-07 §7.6 leaves support optional. Propose that providers SHOULD support it (Mark prefers MAY over SHOULD over MUST), or say plainly that rooms with metadata exclude clients without it. After IETF 127, with the other WG items (IETF-xqv6).
